question.worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{4}[{\int }_{0}^{4}({5}^{y-3}\sqrt{x})\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{3}^{4}{5}^{y-3}[{\int }_{0}^{4}\sqrt{x}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{3}^{4}{5}^{y-3}{[\frac{2}{3}{(\sqrt{x})}^{3}]}_{0}^{4}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{3}^{4}{5}^{y-3}(\frac{2}{3}{(\sqrt{4})}^{3}-\frac{2}{3}{(\sqrt{0})}^{3})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{3}^{4}\frac{16\cdot {5}^{y-3}}{3}\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

 

Then, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{4}\frac{16\cdot {5}^{y-3}}{3}\,\text{d}y & =\frac{16}{3}{[\frac{{5}^{y-3}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}]}_{3}^{4} \\  & =\frac{16}{3}(\frac{{5}^{4-3}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}-\frac{{5}^{3-3}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}) \\  & =\frac{16}{3}(\frac{5-1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}) \\  & =\frac{64}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡5}\end{aligned}
$$
